_comment: Safe public defaults. Real per-machine slot configuration belongs in
appsettings.Local.json (gitignored), layered on top of this file at startup.
Run `workbenchbridge-cli configure` to push Local.json into the service
folder, seed any missing com0com pairs, and restart the services.

Pi._comment: Raspberry Pi running the RFC 2217 endpoint per ESP32 slot.

WindowsServices._comment: SCM names the CLI stops/restarts during `configure`.

Registry._comment: HKLM-relative path holding com0com CNCA{n}/CNCB{n} subkeys.

Tools._comment: Filesystem locations of com0com (used by `configure` for setupc.exe seeding only) and esptool.

_comment: Each entry is one bridged slot. User side is what the IDE opens;
Internal side is what the RFC 2217 bridge opens. They form a com0com
pair via matching CNCA{n}/CNCB{n} registry subkeys (same {n}).
File logging for the service (writer) and CLI (reader/clearer). Three clearly-
named streams under Directory: service-<period>.log (controller/generic control),
cli-<period>.log (CLI invocations), and port-COMxx-<period>.log (one per bridged
COM port, including --raw serial). Files roll per RollingInterval (Hour|Day) and
are purged after RetentionDays. PortFileSizeMB is small so a busy --raw capture
rolls more often. Use `workbenchbridge-cli logs --where` to see the live files.
